cast: Catherine Morland, a cheerful, unpolished seventeen-year-old with a large appetite for novels
Mrs. Allen, the neighbour who takes her to Bath and thinks chiefly about muslin
Henry Tilney, a young clergyman who talks in teasing paradoxes and claims to know gowns
Isabella Thorpe, a warm, worldly new friend who is quick with superlatives
John Thorpe, her brother, loud about his horses, his carriage and his own honesty
General Tilney, Henry's attentive and exacting father
details.pacing: Short chapters and fast comic dialogue; the Bath half is almost all talk and social manoeuvring, and the story only turns towards the abbey past the midpoint.
contentNotes: a young woman abruptly turned out of a house and sent home alone
a controlling, mercenary father

books.hook: A novel-mad girl goes to Bath, meets a teasing clergyman, and starts reading ordinary life as though it were gothic fiction.
